founder_requests.quote: Intros to procurement leads at hardware enterprises.

payload.engagement: You are the accelerator/advisory team. Assess the target and write the work you would deliver. Do not advise the company to hire another accelerator.

suitability_decision.rationale: The early-stage company has asked for help reaching procurement leads at hardware enterprises. A sourced prospect brief and a proposed outreach strategy would address that request. Initial preparation is useful without claiming the company is ready for investment or that we can guarantee introductions.
suitability_decision.next_action: Prepare a researched procurement-lead prospect brief and draft a founder proposal to confirm outreach scope.

draft.title: Waybill: Test procurement automation for hardware teams
draft.purpose: Decide whether Waybill's procurement automation can reduce hardware teams' time spent on sourcing and logistics.

sections.heading: Reason to investigate
sections.content: Waybill claims to automate procurement for hardware teams, handling sourcing, freight, customs, and inventory. The source does not establish customer count, time saved, or cost savings.

sections.heading: Objection and decisive test
sections.content: Hardware teams may not adopt procurement automation if it fails to reduce time spent on sourcing and logistics. Match time spent on procurement tasks before and after Waybill's implementation, then deduct cost savings and customer retention.

missing_inputs.record: Customer count, time spent on procurement tasks before and after Waybill's implementation, and cost savings per customer
missing_inputs.why: These records distinguish time saved and cost reduction from customer adoption and retention.

draft.decision_question: Does Waybill's procurement automation reduce time spent on sourcing and logistics for hardware teams?
draft.next_action: Prepare a customer-time-savings analysis and request the corresponding customer count, time spent, and cost savings records.
draft.completion_test: The analysis reconciles customer time spent on procurement tasks before and after Waybill's implementation to savings and retention, and explains missing records, unpaid balances, and adverse contribution.
